instruction: Format “Approved” in green text (#008000), give “Needs Review” a yellow background (#FFFF00), and format “Rejected” in red text (#FF0000). Preserve all other text and formatting.

states.value:
Review Status Register
Approved — the submission contains the required evidence and can proceed to publication.
Needs Review — the submission requires a source check before a final decision is recorded.
Rejected — the submission does not meet the stated acceptance criteria.
